item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00037","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C15","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C11 provides a concrete letter template for transmitting a large appropriation request to Congress: the child closely repeats its opening transmission formula, fiscal-year and agency-specific appropriation structure, urgent national-security justification, recommendation for prompt action, and closing reference to the attached Bureau of the Budget letter with presidential concurrence. C15 and C21 use much of the same appropriation-message framework, but C11 is the closest overall verbal and structural match.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Sir: I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress the Budget for the fiscal year 1952 in the amount of $535,000,000 for the Federal Civil Defense Administration.","parent_excerpt":"Sir: I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation for the fiscal year 1951 in the amount of $89,000,000 for the Department of State and the General Services Administration.","explanation":"Nearly identical opening transmission formula, with fiscal year, amount, and recipient agency adapted to the new program."},{"child_excerpt":"Because of the importance of Civil Defense in the protection of our people, property and production on the home front, I recommend immediate action on this appropriation in the interest of national security.","parent_excerpt":"I regard such an expanded campaign of truth as vital to our National Security.","explanation":"Both frame the requested program and appropriation as vital to national security, supporting urgent congressional action."},{"child_excerpt":"The details of these proposed appropriations are set forth in the attached letter from the Director of the Bureau of the Budget with whose comments and observations thereon I concur.","parent_excerpt":"The details of these estimates are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I Concur.","explanation":"This is a close reuse of the same distinctive closing clause identifying the attached Budget Director's letter and expressly concurring in its comments and observations."}]}
